_notes: Censer of Embers: the living fire at the feet. One painted 1774x887 sheet, a 2x2 grid read left to right, top to bottom (cell 4 loops back to cell 1), two flame clumps on a bed of coals, the coal line on the same row ~85% down each cell, on a #00FF00 green screen. Keyed on hue with keyed: "green-soft". No crop and no per-frame centring: every frame keeps its cell's canvas so the base does not jump between frames. Rows are 443 and 444 px; the 443 row is padded by one transparent row at the bottom onto the shared 887x444 canvas.
